description: Use this when the user wants a mug designed or personalised. Turns a design description into a link that opens the LivaGlow designer with the finished draft (texts, cliparts, background, photo placeholder, optional template). If the user already gave a text or an occasion, build the draft with sensible defaults; they can change it afterwards. Nothing is stored or ordered: the customer opens the link, checks the 3D preview, uploads their photo if a placeholder is present, and orders. Everything is placed automatically: with a photo, texts and cliparts form a column next to it, otherwise a centred column. A template only fits its own text slots, which replace in order: for your own wording, extra texts or cliparts leave template out and use items with photo. Photos cannot be passed; use photo:{shape} to reserve a placeholder. Call get_design_options first for valid fonts, cliparts and templates. Do not use it for hateful, harassing or illegal print content.

background.description: Background: preset id (e.g. "schwarz", "nacht", "creme", "sonnenuntergang"), a colour "#rrggbb", {kind:"solid",color:"#rrggbb"} or {kind:"gradient",from:"#rrggbb",to:"#rrggbb",angle:135}. Text colour adapts automatically unless set.

items.description: Texts and cliparts in top-to-bottom order

arc.description: Curve the text: negative = arch down, positive = arch up

size.description: Font size in print px (auto if omitted)

layout.description: Column for automatically placed items (default: opposite the photo, else center)

photo.description: Reserve a photo placeholder the customer fills in the designer

name: create_design_link

previewUrl.description: PNG of the flat print area

shipping.description: Shipping of the default method below the free-shipping threshold
